Tom believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The school gate has become an important part of daily life. For example, a visiting scholar joined the lab for spring term.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The experience taught Tom more than any book could. Tom wrote down every idea in a small notebook. What's more, campus radio broadcasts the finals live.
